identity.name: Nikkei Asia
identity.description: The English-language Asia-focused publication of Nikkei Inc., covering business, markets, technology, politics and supply chains across the region.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Privately held Japanese media group. Nikkei acquired the Financial Times in 2015, giving it a transcontinental business-news footprint and close ties to Japanese corporate and financial circles.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Editorial independence from the Japanese government is maintained, but the publication has structural proximity to Japanese corporate and financial interests.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: MBFC rates Right-Center and High factual reporting; pro-business framing and a Japanese allied perspective on regional security.

economicPerspective.evidence: Coverage consistently frames events through corporate strategy, investment and market impact.

internationalAlignment.evidence: Regional security is framed through Japanese and allied interests, with critical but measured coverage of China.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: MBFC rates factual reporting High and credibility High; deep institutional reporting and named sourcing.

externalRatings.notes: MBFC: Right-Center; factual reporting High; credibility High (retrieved 2026-10-25).

intelligence.knownPerspective: Japanese business-establishment voice. Explains Asian events through supply chains, corporate strategy, trade and Japan's alliance relationships, with detailed techno-industrial coverage.

selectionRationale: Provides unmatched English-language Asian business and supply-chain depth, complementing political wires and China-focused outlets.
